title: Polynomial list approximating a single-output $\mathrm{AC}^0[p]$ circuit
statement: Let $p$ be a prime and let $F$ be a layered feedforward circuit over the Boolean alphabet $\mathrm{Fin}\,2$, with inputs indexed by $\mathrm{Fin}\,n$, finitely many nodes in every layer, and a single output node, and suppose every gate of $F$ belongs to the $\mathrm{AC}^0[p]$ gate set (the identity, NOT, unbounded fan-in AND, and unbounded $\mathrm{MOD}_p$ gates of every arity). Then for every $\ell \in \bbn$ there is a nonempty list $P_1,\dots,P_m$ of polynomials in the variables $\{X_i : i \in \mathrm{Fin}\,n\}$ over $\bbz/p$, each of total degree at most $\bigl((p-1)\ell\bigr)^{\mathrm{depth}(F)}$, with the following property. For a Boolean input $x : \mathrm{Fin}\,n \to \mathrm{Fin}\,2$, write $\hat{x} \in (\bbz/p)^n$ for the point whose $i$-th coordinate is the image of $x_i$ in $\bbz/p$, and let $b(x) \in \bbz/p$ be the image of the single Boolean value output by $F$ on $x$. Then for every such $x$, the number of indices $j$ with $P_j(\hat{x}) \neq b(x)$, multiplied by $2^{\ell}$, is at most $s \cdot m$, where $s$ is the total number of non-input gates of $F$ and $m$ is the length of the list.

replaced:
Let $p$ be a prime, and let $F$ be a layered feedforward circuit over the Boolean
alphabet $\mathrm{Fin}\,2$, with input coordinates indexed by $\mathrm{Fin}\,n$ and a
single output node, each of whose layers has finitely many nodes and all of whose gates
belong to the $\mathrm{AC}^0[p]$ gate set. Then for every $\ell \in \bbn$ there is a
nonempty list $Ps$ of multivariate polynomials over $\bbz/p$ in the variables indexed by
$\mathrm{Fin}\,n$ such that every entry $P$ of $Ps$ has total degree at most
$\mathrm{circuitDegreeBound}(p,\ell,\mathrm{depth}(F)) =
\bigl((p-1)\ell\bigr)^{\mathrm{depth}(F)}$, and for every Boolean input $x :
\mathrm{Fin}\,n \to \mathrm{Fin}\,2$ the number of entries $P$ of $Ps$ whose value
$P\bigl(\mathrm{boolInput}_p(x)\bigr)$ disagrees with the circuit's single Boolean
output on $x$, cast into $\bbz/p$, multiplied by $2^{\ell}$, is at most
$\mathrm{gateCountBefore}(F,\mathrm{depth}(F)) \cdot \abs{Ps}$.
